source: written for this kit from workloads/project-tracker-xl/instruction.md only; generated by scripts/gen-hidden-tests-manifest.mjs, one <area>.test.ts per area of workloads/project-tracker-xl/areas.json

tests.name: register returns the user with a trimmed, lowercased email and never a password or hash
register rejects invalid emails, passwords, names, handles and bodies
register accepts boundary values: password 8 and 200 chars, name 100 chars, handle 3 and 20 chars
email_taken is case-insensitive and is checked before handle_taken
login returns a fresh token of at least 20 chars, not starting with trk_, with expiresAt = now + tokenTtlMs
login answers 401 invalid_credentials for a wrong password or unknown email, 400 for non-string fields
authenticated routes answer 401 unauthorized for a missing, malformed, unknown or revoked token
a token expires when now() >= issuedAt + tokenTtlMs
logout answers 204 with no body and revokes only the calling token
POST /me/password validates both fields first, then wrong_password; success revokes every session token but no API key
PATCH /me updates name and handle; another user's handle is 409 handle_taken, one's own is fine
POST /teams makes the caller owner on the defaultPlan; GET /teams lists only the caller's teams, in creation order, with myRole
non-members get 404 not_found, never 403, on every team-scoped route
role checks: member and viewer get 403 on admin+ routes, admin gets 403 on owner-only routes
GET members lists the member shape, oldest joinedAt first
adding a member: bad email or role is 400, unknown email 404 user_not_found, an existing member 409 already_member
the members quota is checked after already_member: a free team of 5 refuses a 6th with quota_exceeded details
PATCH a member's role: admin, member or viewer only; a userId that is not a member is 404
changing the owner's role or removing the owner is 409 owner_required, even by the owner
members may remove themselves; removing someone else needs admin+; member.added and member.removed go through the pipeline
leaving cascades: cards unassigned (archived ones too), watching, private views, timer and user field values go, nothing else changes
transfer makes the target owner and the caller admin, and answers the team as the caller now sees it
transfer to a non-member, an unknown id, oneself or without userId is 400 invalid_body
deleting a team removes it and everything in it for every member
POST project answers the project shape with archived false and description defaulting to empty
a key must match ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,5}$ exactly
keys are unique within a team (archived included) and freed by delete; the projects quota comes after key_taken
PATCH updates name, description and archived and moves updatedAt; a key in the body is 400
GET projects filters by ?archived=false|true|all (default false), oldest first; other values are 400 invalid_query
an archived project answers 409 project_archived on every write inside it; watching still works and reads are unchanged
in an archived project comment writes are refused, a running timer can be stopped and its entry deleted; unarchiving restores writes
project_archived is checked after visibility, role and validation (steps 5-8) and before the route's other 409s
DELETE project removes everything in it: boards, cards, fields, sprints, templates, dependencies, storage, and disables rules on it
a new board gets the default columns To do, In progress, Done at positions 0..2 with categories todo, in_progress, done
columns given on create keep array order and get categories by position; 0 or 21 columns or a bad name is 400
boards list oldest first; PATCH renames a board
adding a column at a position shifts the later columns right; default is the end and category todo
PATCH a column's position moves it and keeps the others' relative order
wipLimit is null or an integer from 1 to 1000 and category one of todo, in_progress, done; a limit may go below the card count
a column becoming a done column completes its cards, and leaving done clears them, as a silent cascade
DELETE column: the last column is 409 last_column; non-archived cards make it 409 column_not_empty; archived ones go to position 0
DELETE column ?moveTo appends its cards to the end of the target, in order, ignoring the WIP limit, with the completion rule
an invalid ?moveTo is 400 invalid_query, even for an empty column or a board's last column
members and viewers get 403 on board and column writes; an admin's write-scope API key gets insufficient_scope
DELETE board removes its columns, cards and recurrences
deleting a column moves its recurrences to moveTo or deletes them, and disables the rules that reference it
a card has the documented shape and defaults, key <project key>-<number> and createdBy
card numbers count per project across its boards and are never reused after a delete
labels are trimmed, lowercased, de-duplicated and sorted; more than 10 distinct is 400
title, description, dueDate, priority, points and sprintId validation, including impossible calendar dates
assigneeId must be an owner, admin or member; the validation order is invalid_body, invalid_assignee, then field values
creating at a position shifts later cards down; deleting closes the gap; neighbours keep updatedAt
moving a card to another column of the same board puts it at the requested index; other boards and bad bodies are 400
moving within a column reorders it, keeps the others' order, and still emits card.moved and a history entry
completedAt is set on entering a done column, kept between done columns and on reorder, and cleared on leaving
a blocked card cannot move into a done column (409 blocked, before the WIP limit) but can be created there, move between done columns and leave
creating in or moving into a full column is 409 wip_limit_reached; reordering inside it is allowed; archived cards don't count
the cards quota counts every card of the team, archived cards and archived projects included, and is checked before the WIP limit
the due job emits card.due once, actor null and via schedule, on the first request at or after the start of the dueDate
the due job is rescheduled by a new dueDate, cancelled by null, a past date or a delete, and skipped for completed or archived cards
GET board cards lists non-archived cards by column position then card position; ?columnId filters; a foreign or empty column is 400
PATCH changes only the given fields and updatedAt, and emits card.updated with the sorted body fields
the response shows the state after the rules ran while the event snapshot does not; rule changes follow with their own via, actor and audit
viewers get 403 on every card write; API keys need the write scope for card writes and act with the owner's role
the card error order: 404 unseen column, 403 role, 400 body, invalid_assignee, invalid_field_value, field_required, then the 409s
deleting a card deletes its comments, checklist, attachments and dependencies, and emits card.deleted with the card as it was
comments come back as trees: top-level oldest first, direct replies oldest first, to any depth
parentId must be a comment on the same card; body is 1 to 5000 chars; a comment emits comment.created and leaves the card's updatedAt
mentions follow the regex and membership rules, in order of first appearance, without duplicates
mentions are recomputed on PATCH; a handle change only affects mentions written after it
PATCH is for the author only (403 even for the owner); an author demoted to viewer can still edit and delete
DELETE is for the author or admin+; another member gets 403
delete is soft and keeps the replies; writes to a deleted comment are 409 comment_deleted and to an archived card's comments 409 card_archived
GET /me/mentions lists the caller's live mentions newest first, across teams; leaving hides them and rejoining shows them again
GET /me/mentions pages with limit and cursor (default 20); a bad limit or cursor is 400 invalid_query
a handle counts only while its user is a current member of the card's team, in any role
q matches term prefixes in titles, descriptions and non-deleted comments; every term must match
score is the sum over terms of 3*t + d + c, highest first, ties by creation order
without q, and between equal scores, results come in card creation order
tokenizing lowercases and splits on every non-alphanumeric character; a q with no terms is no condition
projectId, boardId and columnId narrow the results; ids from elsewhere simply match nothing
assigneeId filters by assignee, and assigneeId=none means unassigned
label may repeat; values are trimmed and lowercased and the card must have every label
dueFrom and dueTo are inclusive and exclude cards without a dueDate; bad dates are 400 invalid_query
cards of archived projects are searched only with includeArchived=true; archived cards never
cursor pagination visits every match exactly once, in order, with total on every page
invalid queries answer 400 invalid_query: limit, cursor, q length and term count
search never returns another team's cards; viewers may search, non-members get 404
priority, sprintId (and none), category and blocked filter the results; bad values are 400 invalid_query
a cursor belongs to its route: one issued by another paginated route is 400 invalid_query, as are empty limit and cursor
create returns the secret, no other route does, a generated secret has at least 32 chars; the webhooks quota counts inactive ones
url and events are validated against the event table; events are de-duplicated and sorted, and any list with * is stored as [*]
PATCH and rotate-secret move updatedAt; later deliveries are signed with the new secret; DELETE removes the webhook
a delivery POSTs the documented body and headers, signed with HMAC-SHA256 of the exact body
every documented request event fires exactly once with its data, and cascades emit nothing
events of rule actions carry via { type: rule, ruleId, runId } and the rule creator as actor, queued after the triggering event
the events filter is respected; inactive webhooks get nothing but test pings
a failed attempt is retried after retryDelaysMs with the same body bytes and an incremented attempt header
exhausted retries mark the delivery failed after 1 + retryDelaysMs.length attempts
a timeout or a connection error fails the attempt with lastStatusCode null and a non-empty lastError
deleting a webhook cancels its pending retries; deactivating one does not
deliveries are listed newest first with cursor pages; members, viewers and non-admin-scope keys get 403 on every webhook route
GET /health answers { ok: true } without auth and carries no rate-limit headers
counted requests carry x-ratelimit-limit, -remaining and -reset for the fixed window
the spec example: limit 2, windowMs 60000, clock at 1000000
a 429 has no other effect and is not counted
budgets are per credential: two tokens of the same user count separately, and an API key apart from its owner's tokens
public routes (GET /plans included), unknown routes and 401s carry no rate-limit headers and are not counted
the rate limit comes right after authentication: requests refused at 3a, 3b or later are counted, and so is a replay
a request answered 429 still runs the scheduler's due jobs first
the data file holds version 2 and the new state, pipeline effects included, as soon as a mutating response arrives
a new app on the same file sees exactly the same state
after a restart the next card number continues, unexpired tokens and API keys work, revoked, deleted or expired ones stay invalid
the file never holds a plain-text password or API key secret, and webhook secrets survive a restart
a missing file is an empty state, and the file is created on the first write
createApp throws synchronously on invalid JSON and on an unsupported version
pending jobs survive a restart: a due job and a recurrence run when they are due on the new app
rate-limit counters, delivery records, idempotent responses and cursors do not survive a restart
a 1.x file is copied byte for byte to <dataFile>.v1.bak and rewritten as version 2 before createApp returns
migrated users keep their ids and 1.x passwords; emails are trimmed and lowercased
handles are derived from emails in file order, with collisions (_2) and padding of short handles
teams, roles (manager/editor/reader) and members are migrated, owner first, on the defaultPlan; the audit log starts empty
boards get their columns, WIP limits and categories by position; cards land in their column, or the first one, ordered by `order`
card fields: labels from tags, dueDate from UTC timestamps, description from notes, assignee only for owner/admin/member, 2.0 defaults
card numbers follow createdAt per project, ties in file order; the next number continues and new cards sort last
comments keep parentId only for a parent on the same card, and mentions are recomputed with the migrated handles
a migrated card gets a due job only when the start of its dueDate is later than now() at load
team, member, plan and project writes each append one entry with the documented action, target, details and via
board, column, card (archive and restore included) and comment writes append their entries
webhook writes append entries; test pings, reads and failed writes add nothing
failed requests, reads, /me routes, watching, dry-run imports and cascades add nothing
the log is newest first and pages with limit and cursor; a bad limit or cursor is 400 invalid_query
?action= and ?actorId= filter exactly and combine; values that match nothing give an empty list
admin+ only: members and viewers get 403, non-members 404; the log goes with its team
rule actions append their own entries after the request's, as the rule's creator with via rule
scheduler jobs: a recurrence run appends card.created via the recurrence, the trash purge card.purged with no actor, the due job nothing
every new kind of change appends one entry with its documented action, target and details
create answers the key with its secret: trk_ and at least 32 alphanumerics, prefix its first 12 chars
list and get show the caller's own keys, oldest first, and never a secret
create validates name, scope, teamId and expiresAt; expiresAt is stored as an ISO string
PATCH changes name and expiresAt and moves updatedAt; scope or teamId in the body is 400
DELETE revokes a key at once; another user's key id is 404 on every :keyId route
a user holds at most 20 keys: the 21st is 409 quota_exceeded { apiKeys, 20, 20 }, after validation
a key acts as its owner: createdBy, authorId, the audit actorId and the event actorId are the owner's id
a key has its owner's role at the time of the request: a demotion takes effect at once and a promotion restores access
a key expires when now() >= expiresAt; clearing expiresAt with a session token brings it back
api_key_not_allowed: a key may never log out, change /me, the password, API keys, or accept an invitation, whatever its scope
a team-restricted key may not create a team; an unrestricted write key may, as its owner
3a comes before the body and path checks: api_key_not_allowed before 413, invalid_json and 404, then insufficient_scope
insufficient_scope: a read key on every kind of write, checked before the path resources
routes whose Role starts with admin+ or is owner need an admin key, GETs included; other writes need write
scope and role are separate: a member's or a viewer's admin key still gets 403 forbidden from the role check
the /me routes a key may use follow the method rule: GETs need read, POST and PUT need write
a team-restricted key sees only its team: other teams and everything in them are 404, and GET /teams lists one team
a team-restricted key's mentions, notifications and unread count leave out the other teams
a team-restricted key's activity, timer and invitations leave out the other teams
a team-restricted key keeps working when its owner leaves the team, and then sees nothing of it
an unrestricted key follows its owner's membership: removed means 404, re-added with another role means that role
only the exact secret authenticates: a forged key with a real prefix, a truncated or extended secret are 401
teamId must name a team the caller belongs to; after that team is deleted the key still authenticates and sees no team
GET /plans is public and lists free, team and business with exactly the limits table, keys in table order
GET /teams/:teamId/plan answers plan, limits and usage with the seven keys in table order; a new team is on the free plan
the defaultPlan option is the plan of every new team, shown on the team and its plan
defaultPlan applies to migrated teams, whose usage is counted from the 1.x data and whose quotas apply from then on
usage counts archived projects and cards, inactive webhooks, disabled rules and inactive recurrences
storageBytes is the size of the distinct sha256 values among the team's attachments; a delete frees bytes only when no copy is left
the projects quota: a free team's fourth project is 409 quota_exceeded, checked after validation and key_taken, archived projects counting
the cards quota counts every card of the team, archived ones included, and comes before wip_limit_reached, also on template instantiation
the members quota: a free team holds 5 members; it is checked after user_not_found and already_member
pending invitations count toward the members quota on create, not counting one to the same email; accept checks the members alone
the webhooks quota is checked after validation: a free team holds 2 webhooks, inactive ones included
the rules quota is checked after validation: a free team holds 3 rules, disabled ones included
the recurrences quota is checked after validation: a free team holds 2 recurrences, inactive ones included
the storageBytes quota: an upload that would pass 1 MiB is quota_exceeded, but bytes the team already stores always pass
the fixed checklistItems limit: 50 items per card is quota_exceeded with resource checklistItems, whatever the plan
the fixed apiKeys limit: 20 keys per user is quota_exceeded with resource apiKeys, whatever the plan
the fixed fields limit: 30 custom fields per project is quota_exceeded with resource fields, even on the business plan
PUT plan upgrades and downgrades and answers the new plan, limits and usage; the team shows the new plan
PUT plan is owner only (403 for admins, members and viewers, 404 for non-members) and plan must be free, team or business
a downgrade over the new limits is 409 downgrade_blocked listing those limits in table order, and changes nothing
setting the plan the team already has answers 200, changes nothing and appends no audit entry, whatever the usage
a plan change is audited as team.plan_changed with from and to, and quotas follow the new plan at once
PUT plan needs an admin-scoped key before 404 and ignores Idempotency-Key; a POST refused by a quota stores no idempotent response
a repeated POST with the same key and body replays the status and exact body bytes with idempotency-replayed: true, and does nothing else
the same key with different body bytes is 409 idempotency_conflict, even when the JSON means the same
an Idempotency-Key must be 1 to 100 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_.:-], else 400 invalid_header
a response that is not 2xx stores nothing: after a failure the same key and body run again
the scope is (user, method, path, key): another path or user is unrelated, another credential of the same user is not
a stored response expires after idempotencyTtlMs: until then it replays, from then on the request runs and stores anew
stored responses are not persisted: after a restart the same key and body run again
PATCH, PUT and DELETE ignore the header, even an invalid one
the public POST routes ignore the header: register validates nothing of it, login issues a new token every time
a replay answers what was stored even after the state changed, including a 204 and a 202, with no new effect
3b sits after 3a and before the body and path checks: a replay skips them, invalid_header and idempotency_conflict come first
a replayed POST runs no pipeline: no second rule run, notification, activity entry or delivery, on routes of several areas
a field has the documented shape; select options are stored trimmed, other types store [], required defaults to false
a field name is trimmed, 1 to 50 chars, and unique within its project compared case-insensitively
type must be one of the eight types and never changes: a PATCH with type is 400 invalid_body
options are required for select and multiselect (1 to 50 distinct trimmed strings of 1 to 50 chars) and forbidden for other types
fields list oldest first; viewers read, members and viewers get 403 on definition writes, non-members 404
PATCH a field renames it, sets required and options, and moves updatedAt; a name another field holds is field_name_taken
at most 30 fields per project: the quota is checked after field_name_taken and freed by a delete
text values are trimmed to 1 to 500 chars; number values must be finite JSON numbers
date values are real YYYY-MM-DD dates; checkbox values are booleans and false is a stored value
select values equal an option exactly; multiselect values are non-empty arrays of options, de-duplicated in options order
user values are ids of current team members in any role; url values are absolute http or https URLs of at most 2000 chars
invalid_field_value names the first offending key in body order, unknown keys and keys of other projects included
on card create customFields must be an object, null for a field of the project is ignored, and the default is {}
PATCH merges customFields: a value sets that field, null removes it, keys not given are kept
PUT and DELETE of a card value answer the card, move updatedAt and emit card.updated with fields [customFields], even with nothing to change
PUT needs a non-null value; a field of another project, an unknown field or an unknown card is 404 not_found first
card create validation order: invalid_body, then invalid_assignee, then invalid_field_value, then field_required
a required field without a value on card create is 400 field_required naming the first missing field in creation order
removing a required value by PATCH null or DELETE is field_required; making a field required checks nothing
a PATCH of options removes stale select and multiselect values from cards and templates, without updatedAt changes or events
deleting a field removes its values from cards and templates and disables the rules that reference it
search field.<id> on text, select, date, url and user matches the value exactly; multiselect matches containment and repeats must all match
search field.<id> on number and checkbox validates the value; checkbox false matches false or unset only in the field's project; unknown fields match nothing
a set_field rule action succeeds, is a noop when the value is already there, and fails invalid_field_value once its option is removed
when a user leaves the team, user-type field values naming them are removed from cards and templates by cascade
field writes are audited: field.created, field.updated with the sorted body fields, field.deleted; a failed write adds nothing
an archived project answers 409 project_archived on field definitions and values; an archived card answers card_archived; validation comes first
API keys: field definitions need an admin key, checked before 404; value writes need write scope; a key acts with its owner's current role
an Idempotency-Key replay of POST fields answers the stored field and creates nothing; another body with the key is idempotency_conflict
a set_field action runs as the rule's creator: its own audit entry and a card.updated event via the rule, after the request's
a label has the documented shape: the name trimmed and lowercased, the color stored lowercase with #888888 by default
label names must be 1 to 30 chars after trimming; colors must be # followed by 6 hex digits
label names are unique within the team, also on rename (409 label_taken); another team may reuse a name
labels are listed by name ascending; viewers read; members and viewers get 403 on writes; non-members get 404
creating a label changes no card, and card labels need not be in the catalogue
a PATCH of the color only changes the color and updatedAt; a PATCH needs an updatable field
a rename rewrites the labels of every card of the team, archived projects and archived cards included, de-duplicated and re-sorted
a rename emits no events and appends only its own label.updated entry
a rename rewrites the labels of templates and recurrences
a rename rewrites label conditions and add_label / remove_label actions of rules, which stay enabled
a rename rewrites the label values of saved views, and the view's cards follow
a delete removes the name from the labels of cards, templates and recurrences and from saved views, without updatedAt changes or events
a delete disables every rule that uses the name in a condition or an action, definition unchanged; other rules stay enabled
merge rewrites the merged name into the target's everywhere, rules included and not disabled, deletes the source and answers the target unchanged
merge needs intoLabelId naming another label of the same team, else 400 invalid_body, and changes nothing
label writes are audited: label.created, label.updated with sorted fields, label.merged with into, label.deleted
API keys: label writes need an admin key, checked before 404; a team-restricted key does not see another team's labels
an Idempotency-Key replay of POST labels answers the stored label and creates nothing; the key with another body is idempotency_conflict
adding a blocker answers the dependency and makes the blocked card blocked, not the blocker
blockerId must be a card of the same team, in any of its projects, and not the card itself
adding the same dependency twice is 409 dependency_exists
a direct two-card cycle is 409 dependency_cycle with details.path from the new blocker to the card
the spec example: with C blocked by A and B blocked by C, adding A blocked by B answers path [B, C, A]
dependency_cycle reports the breadth-first path, visiting each card's blockers in link creation order
blocked is true only while an open blocker exists: a completed or archived blocker is not open
a blocked card cannot move into a done column (409 blocked) but may move between done columns and out of one
on move, 409 blocked comes after card_archived and before wip_limit_reached
the move_to_column action fails with blocked on a blocked card and moves an unblocked one, as the rule's creator
blockers and blocking list cards in the order the dependencies were created, archived cards included
DELETE of a blocker answers 204 and unblocks; a card that is not a blocker of it is 404 not_found
project_archived applies when either card is in an archived project; reads still work and unarchiving restores writes
card_archived applies when either card is archived, after project_archived
deleting a card removes the dependencies that involve it, in both directions
deleting a project removes every dependency that involves one of its cards
dependencies emit no events and are audited as dependency.added and dependency.removed on the blocked card
viewers read the lists but get 403 on blocker writes; non-members get 404
a column becoming a done column completes its cards and so unblocks the cards they block; turning it back blocks them again
blocked follows the dependencies on every card read: the board list and search blocked=true|false
API keys: a read key gets 403 insufficient_scope on blocker writes even for an unknown card; a write key acts as its owner
an Idempotency-Key replay of POST blockers answers the stored dependency and adds nothing; without the key a repeat is dependency_exists
a new sprint is planned and has the documented shape; the name is trimmed and goal defaults to empty
sprint validation: name 1 to 100 chars trimmed, goal at most 500 chars, real dates with endDate >= startDate
sprints list by startDate ascending then creation order, filter by ?state (default all), and other values are invalid_query
sprint routes: viewers read, members may only change a sprint's cards, admin+ manages sprints, non-members get 404
start makes a planned sprint active with startedAt now and committedPoints from its non-archived cards, null counting 0
start answers sprint_state unless the sprint is planned, and sprint_active while another sprint of the project is active
complete answers sprint_state unless the sprint is active; its body must be a JSON object
complete sets completedPoints from completed non-archived cards and carries open non-archived cards to a planned sprint
complete without carryOverTo leaves the open cards in no sprint, without changing their updatedAt
carryOverTo must be another planned sprint of the same project, else 400 invalid_body
a completed sprint is frozen: no card enters or leaves it by POST cards, DELETE cards or a card PATCH of sprintId
PATCH of a planned sprint changes any field, checks the date pair after the change and moves updatedAt
PATCH of an active sprint may change name and goal and resend its dates; other dates are sprint_state; a completed sprint is sprint_state
DELETE removes only a planned sprint; its cards get sprintId null by cascade, without updatedAt changes or events
POST sprint cards adds the listed cards, answers the sprint's cards by number, and leaves cards already in it alone
POST sprint cards emits card.updated with fields [sprintId] per changed card in body order, and one sprint.cards_added entry
POST sprint cards that changes no card answers the cards but appends no audit entry and emits nothing
POST sprint cards moves a card from another planned or active sprint into this one
cardIds must be a non-empty array of at most 100 distinct ids of non-archived cards of the sprint's project
DELETE of a sprint card clears sprintId, moves updatedAt, emits card.updated [sprintId] and appends sprint.card_removed; a card not in it is 404
an archived card keeps its sprint, leaves the sprint's card list, and removing it is 409 card_archived
a card's sprintId is null or a planned or active sprint of its project; PATCH sprintId is audited and emitted as card.updated
GET sprint cards lists its non-archived cards by number ascending, however they joined
burndown has one entry per date; dates after today are null; remaining sums points of cards not completed before the end of each date
burndown reads the current cards: a reopened card counts on every past date, and a card added later counts too
velocity lists completed sprints most recently completed first, takes the first count, and rounds the average to 2 decimals
velocity ties on completedAt put the later-created sprint first; no completed sprint gives average null; a bad count is invalid_query
sprint writes are audited: created, updated with sorted fields, started, completed with carryOverTo, deleted; failed writes add nothing
start and complete emit sprint.started and sprint.completed with the sprint snapshot; carried-over cards emit nothing
an archived project answers 409 project_archived on every sprint write, before sprint_state; reads still work
the add_to_sprint action puts the card in the active sprint as the rule's creator, and fails not_found when there is none
API keys and idempotency on sprint routes: admin+ routes need an admin key before 404, card lists a write key, and a replay creates one sprint
deleting a sprint disables the rules whose add_to_sprint action references it; a rule using active stays enabled
a checklist item has the documented shape: text trimmed, not done, doneAt and doneBy null, updatedAt equal to createdAt
item text is 1 to 200 chars after trimming and position an integer 0 .. n; anything else is 400 invalid_body
creating an item inserts it at position (default the end) and shifts the later items; the list is ordered by position
PATCH position moves the item to that index, keeps the others in order, and only accepts 0 .. n-1
deleting an item closes the gap and answers 204; a deleted item is 404 not_found
done false to true sets doneAt now and doneBy the caller; the same value keeps them; true to false clears both; updatedAt always moves
the card's checklist summary follows its items, while checklist changes never move the card's updatedAt
checklist.completed is emitted by the PATCH that marks the last open item done, with the card snapshot, and not again while all stay done
checklist.completed on DELETE: deleting the last open item completes; deleting a done item or the only item does not
instantiating a template with a checklist creates open items and emits no checklist.completed; completing them later does
at most 50 items per card: the 51st is 409 quota_exceeded checklistItems, and a delete frees a slot
checklist writes on an archived card are card_archived and in an archived project project_archived, which comes first; reads still work
viewers read checklists but get 403 on writes; non-members get 404 for the card's items
checklist writes are audited: item_created, item_updated with the sorted body fields, item_deleted; they emit no card event
a rule triggered by checklist.completed runs on the event's card: completing the checklist moves the card to the done column
a template has the documented shape and the card defaults; name and title are trimmed, checklist entries trimmed in order
template validation follows the card rules: name 1 to 100, title 1 to 200, labels, priority, points, and a checklist of at most 50 entries of 1 to 200 chars
template customFields must be valid values of the project's fields: null is invalid_body, a bad value or unknown key invalid_field_value; required fields are not checked
PATCH validates only the given fields, replaces customFields as a whole, moves updatedAt, and needs an updatable field
template definitions are admin+; members instantiate, viewers get 403 on both; non-members get 404
instantiating makes a card with the template's content, sprintId null, one open checklist item per entry, the caller as creator and watcher
placeholders {{date}}, {{user}}, {{number}} and {{project}} are replaced everywhere in title and description; anything else is kept
after replacement the title is trimmed and cut to 200 chars and the description cut to 10000
instantiate validation: columnId must be a column of the template's project; assigneeId, dueDate and position follow the card rules
instantiate checks required fields after taking the template's values: 400 field_required names the first missing field
instantiate respects the cards quota and the WIP limit, quota first, and a 409 creates nothing
instantiating is one change: one card.created event and one card.created audit entry, no checklist entries
a template used by a recurrence cannot be deleted (409 template_in_use) until the recurrence is gone; template writes are audited
an archived project answers 409 project_archived on template writes and instantiation, before template_in_use; reads still work
rules run on an instantiated card: the response carries a rule's label while the card.created snapshot does not; a replayed instantiate creates one card
a recurrence has the documented shape: card defaults, a five-key schedule, nextRunAt the first occurrence, run fields null
exactly one of templateId and title: both or neither is invalid_body; with a template the content fields are forbidden and stored null
schedule validation: frequency, interval 1 to 365, HH:MM time, weekdays only and required for weekly, dayOfMonth only and required for monthly
dates, column and assignee validation: endDate >= startDate, a column of this board, a member+ assignee checked after invalid_body
the recurrences quota counts inactive recurrences: the third on the free plan is 409 quota_exceeded after validation
recurrence definitions are admin+; viewers read recurrences and occurrences; non-members get 404
daily occurrences are startDate plus k * interval days at the schedule's time; the default count is 5
only instants later than now count: a series that started in the past continues on its own interval, and an instant equal to now is skipped
weekly occurrences count whole weeks from the Monday on or before startDate, so Sunday ends its week
monthly occurrences step interval months, clamp dayOfMonth to the month's last day, and skip a first date before startDate
endDate is inclusive and ends the series: fewer occurrences, nextRunAt null once finished; count must be an integer 1 to 50
an inactive recurrence has nextRunAt null, still lists occurrences, and never runs; activating it computes nextRunAt from now
PATCH replaces the schedule, recomputes nextRunAt, validates the date pair after the change, and refuses templateId and content on a template recurrence
when nextRunAt has come, the next request runs the recurrence: one card at the end of its column as the creator, and the run fields update
after missed occurrences a run still creates exactly one card, and nextRunAt is the first occurrence later than now
the scheduler runs before every request, also ones answered 401 or 404, and nothing runs between requests
the request that arrives after the due instant already sees the new card, and pending jobs survive a restart
placeholders in a recurrence's title and description are replaced at run time: today, the creator's handle, the number and the project key
a template recurrence takes the template's content at run time, with its checklist and values
a run fails with forbidden when the creator is no longer member+, before project_archived; a failed run keeps lastCardId and still moves on
a run fails with quota_exceeded before wip_limit_reached, and creates nothing
a run fails with wip_limit_reached, then invalid_assignee, then field_required, in that order
a successful run is a change via the recurrence: card.created and its audit entry carry the via, rules run on it, the creator watches; a failed run leaves no trace
due jobs run in due-instant order, then by kind (the due job before a recurrence), then by creation order of their records
deleting a recurrence's column moves it to the moveTo column or deletes it; deleting its board deletes it
recurrence writes are audited and answer 409 project_archived in an archived project, where reads still work
a PATCH of the schedule moves the pending job: the old instant no longer runs, the new one does
a recurrence moved by a column delete runs into its new column; a deleted recurrence never runs
a rule has the documented shape: trigger with four keys, conditions [] by default, enabled, createdBy the caller
trigger validation: one of the six events, projectId a project of the team, toColumnId only with card.moved, fields only with card.updated
trigger filters are stored: projectId, toColumnId, and fields de-duplicated and sorted; a filter not given is null
condition validation: known fields only, the ops each field allows, and values of the right kind; at most 10 conditions
customFields.<fieldId> conditions: a field of the team, the ops its type allows, a value valid for it; is_set is stored with value null
action validation: 1 to 10 known actions with valid keys, notify recipients, sprints of the team, archive_card only last
actions are stored with type and their own keys only, normalised as the target would store them
the rules quota counts disabled rules: the fourth rule on the free plan is 409 quota_exceeded, after validation
rule definitions, tests and runs are admin+; viewers and members read the rules; non-members get 404
PATCH validates only the fields it has, replaces trigger, conditions and actions whole, keeps createdBy and moves updatedAt
deleting a rule deletes its runs: its runs route is 404 and the team's rule runs no longer list them
POST /rules/:ruleId/test answers one boolean per condition and matched, ignoring trigger and enabled, changing nothing and recording no run
title, labels and assigneeId conditions: case-insensitive contains, label membership, exact assignee or null
priority conditions compare in the order none < low < medium < high < urgent; points comparisons are false on null points except eq and ne
columnId, category, dueDate and blocked conditions read the card's current column, due date and open blockers
customFields conditions per type: eq and ne for scalar types, gt/gte/lt/lte for numbers and dates (dates as strings), is_set and is_not_set
a card without a value for the field, a card of another project included, fails every op except is_not_set, ne and not_contains
conditions read the card's current state: a later rule sees an earlier rule's change; the response shows the state after every rule, the snapshot before
rules of an event run in rule creation order, so the last one wins; their runs and audit entries follow that order
a trigger that does not match records no run: the event, projectId, toColumnId and fields filters, and disabled rules
comment.created runs on the comment's card, and card.due runs from the scheduler with actor null while the actions act as the creator
rules chain through events up to automation.maxDepth (default 3): events of depth 3 trigger no rule
automation.maxDepth 1 runs rules only on the request's own events, and maxDepth 0 runs no rule at all
a rule never reacts to its own actions, but does react to another rule's
rule events join the end of the queue: deliveries and audit entries follow queue order, rule changes carry the rule's via and creator
rule-caused events get activity entries with the rule's via, listed in the team, card and creator feeds
set_assignee assigns as the rule's creator: card.updated [assigneeId], its audit entry, an assigned notification and the assignee watching
set_assignee is a noop when already assigned, fails invalid_assignee once the user is no longer member+, and null unassigns
add_label and remove_label are noops when there is nothing to change; add_label on a card with 10 labels fails invalid_body and stops the run
set_priority is a noop when equal: the run succeeds with a noop action and nothing is emitted or audited
move_to_column moves the card to the end of the column like the move route: card.moved, history, completedAt and its audit details
move_to_column outcomes: noop when already there, failed not_found for a column of another board, then blocked before wip_limit_reached
set_field sets a normalised value as a card.updated [customFields] change, is a noop when equal, and null removes the value
set_field fails not_found for a field of another project, field_required when clearing a required field, invalid_field_value once the value is no longer valid
add_comment writes a top-level comment as the rule's creator with placeholders replaced; its mentions notify and the creator starts watching
notify resolves assignee, watchers, creator and member ids when it runs, each once in to order, rule creator and the triggering user included
notify is a noop when nobody is left after membership and notification settings; it appends no audit entry and emits no event
add_to_sprint with a sprint id: joins it as sprint.cards_added, noop when already in it, failed sprint_state for a completed sprint or a card frozen in one
archive_card archives the card as the rule's creator: the response shows it archived, card.archived is emitted and audited
a run has the documented shape; a condition that fails records no_match with no actions, a run that acts records each action
a rule whose creator is no longer an owner or admin of the team is skipped with forbidden, and does nothing
a rule that runs after another rule archived the card is skipped with card_archived
at the first failed action the run fails with its error; the earlier actions' changes stay, emitted and audited, the rest are not_run
run lists are newest first with cursor pagination; the team list filters by ?status and rejects other values
rules and their runs are persisted: after a restart the runs are listed and the rule keeps running
deleting a column a rule references (trigger, condition or action) disables the rule without changing it; re-enabling it is 400
deleting a referenced field, project or board (with its columns) disables the rules that reference it
deleting a team label disables the rules that use its name; merging rewrites their label values and leaves them enabled
a disabled rule can be re-enabled with a PATCH that also replaces the missing reference
rule actions skip the rate limit and idempotency: the caller's budget moves by one per request, and a replay runs no rule
a rule acts only on its own team's events, and other teams' members cannot see its runs
an add_comment rule on comment.created answers each person's comment once and never its own
a notification has the documented shape: an assigned notification for a card created with an assignee
watch and unwatch answer 204 and are idempotent; watchers are members in watching order; viewers may watch; non-members get 404
users start watching when they create a card, when it is assigned to them, and when they comment, once each and in that order
watchers are always current members: a user who leaves stops watching and is not notified
watching and unwatching still work on an archived card and in an archived project
a comment notifies its mentioned members with mention and the card's other watchers with comment; the author and non-members get nothing
assigned is created only when the assignee changes to another non-null user, never for the actor assigning themselves
moved notifies the card's watchers for a move to another column, not the mover, and nothing for a reorder within a column
the due job notifies the assignee and then the watchers, each once, with actor null and via schedule
no due notification for a card that is completed, archived, or in an archived project when its date comes
notification settings default to every type on and nothing muted; PUT needs exactly the seven boolean types and a list of muted project ids
a type switched off suppresses that type, and a mentioned watcher who turned mention off gets no comment notification instead
mutedProjectIds suppresses every card notification of those projects only, never invitations
notifications are visible only while the recipient is a member of their team: hidden after leaving, shown again on rejoining
another user's notification id is 404 not_found on read, unread and delete, and stays untouched
read sets read and readAt now, reading again keeps readAt; unread clears both
read-all marks every visible unread notification read, optionally of one team, and answers how many changed
unread-count counts the visible unread notifications and follows read, unread and delete
the list filters by ?unread and ?teamId; other unread values and an empty value are 400 invalid_query
the list is newest first and following nextCursor visits every notification once
DELETE removes the caller's notification with 204; afterwards it is 404
rule notifications sit outside one-per-event: two notify actions notify the same user twice, and a watcher also gets the move's moved
an assignment made by a rule notifies as the rule's creator, who is never notified of their own action
watchers are read at step 4: a user a rule assigned during the request also gets that request's moved notification
mention recipients come from the comment as created: editing a comment to add a mention notifies nobody
deleting a team deletes its notifications; deleting a card keeps the notifications about it
a team-restricted API key sees only the notifications of its team, in the list, the count and the routes by id
an invitation notifies a registered addressee who is not a member, with the inviter as actor; turning invite off suppresses it
replying makes the reply's author watch; the parent's author, watching since their comment, gets a comment notification
viewers who watch a card get its moved and comment notifications like any watcher
a watching assignee gets a single due notification
instantiating a template with an assignee notifies the assignee with the caller as actor and makes both watch
settings apply only to new notifications and only to their owner
notifications, their read state and watchers survive a restart
a recipient whose settings drop the winning type gets no other type for that event: a muted, mentioned watcher gets nothing
invite notifications can be read and are counted by read-all without membership of their team
an upload answers the attachment: trimmed filename, content type from the header up to ';', size, sha256, uploader and timestamps
the content type is application/octet-stream when the header is absent or empty before ';', otherwise lowercased
filename is trimmed, 1 to 255 chars, without / or \ or control characters, else 400 invalid_query, checked before the body
an empty upload is 400 invalid_body; the bytes are never parsed as JSON
uploads take up to 1 MiB: exactly 1048576 bytes is accepted, one more is 413 body_too_large before the path and the role are checked
GET content answers the exact bytes with content-type, content-length and the quoted sha256 as etag
If-None-Match equal to the etag or * answers 304 with the etag and no body; anything else gets the bytes
attachments list oldest first; viewers read and download, get 403 on writes; non-members and unknown ids get 404
storageBytes counts distinct sha256 values: known bytes upload whatever the usage, new bytes past the limit are quota_exceeded
deleting an attachment frees its bytes only when no other attachment of the team has the same sha256
deleting a card or a project deletes its attachments and frees their bytes
PATCH renames an attachment by the upload's filename rule (400 invalid_body here), moving updatedAt; it is audited with its fields
an upload emits attachment.added with the attachment and is audited with { sha256, size }; rename and delete emit nothing
attachment writes on an archived card are card_archived and in an archived project project_archived, first; downloads still work
an upload with an Idempotency-Key is replayed for the same bytes on the same path, whatever the query, and conflicts for other bytes
API keys: a read key downloads but gets 403 insufficient_scope on uploads even for an unknown card; a write key uploads as its owner
storage is counted per team: the same bytes in another team count there too
an attachment's card and team scope its routes: an attachment of another card is still reachable by id but only inside its team
a large binary upload round-trips byte for byte
attachments and their bytes survive a restart
attachment.added reaches the activity feeds of its card and project
uploads use the 1 MiB limit only on their own route: a JSON route still rejects bodies over 64 KiB
an activity entry has the documented shape: the event's name, actor, via and data, its card and project, at its occurredAt
member events have no card or project; sprint events have the sprint's project and no card
comment, checklist, move and attachment events are filed under their card and project
only events make entries: project, webhook, dependency, time and checklist item writes add none; a failed request adds none
the team feed filters by ?event and ?actorId exactly; empty or unknown values match nothing
the project and card feeds list only their own entries, newest first
/me/activity lists the caller's own entries in teams they belong to; a team-restricted key sees only its team
activity feeds paginate with limit and cursor, visiting every entry once; bad limits and cursors are 400 invalid_query
card history records the creation and every move, within a column too, and by rules, oldest first with timestamps
history records a restore from the card's column to the target; archiving and cascades (column delete, category change) record nothing
cards made from a template or imported from CSV start their history with a creation entry; an import row's move adds one
entries of a deleted card stay in the team and project feeds, while its own feed and history are 404
scheduler events are filed with actor null and via schedule: card.due and the trash purge's card.deleted
viewers read every feed and history; non-members get 404 for the team, project and card routes
deleting a team deletes its activity: its entries leave the actor's own feed
a saved view has the documented shape: private by default, owned by its creator, the name trimmed
a stored query keeps only the search parameters, with label values trimmed and lowercased
every query value must pass the search route's rule for its parameter, else 400 invalid_body; query must be an object
a private view is visible only to its owner, whatever the others' role; the list holds the caller's views and the shared ones, oldest first
a viewer may save private views but gets 403 forbidden for shared: true; members may share
PATCH rights: the owner always, admin+ on a shared view; other members get 403 on a shared view they do not own
DELETE rights: the owner, or admin+ when the view is shared; deleted views are gone for everyone
GET /views/:viewId/cards answers exactly what the search route answers for the stored query
view cards paginate with limit and cursor like search, with total over every page; a bad limit is 400 invalid_query
a view's results are computed when read: cards created, changed or archived later are reflected
view queries honour blocked, includeArchived and category like the search route
a fields condition works like field.<id>; once the field is deleted the condition stays and matches nothing
label rename, merge and delete rewrite the label values of stored queries, as cascades
when a member leaves the team their private views are deleted; their shared views stay
PATCH replaces the query and moves updatedAt; view writes are audited as view.created, view.updated with fields, view.deleted
non-members get 404 for a team's views and for any view of it; a view of another team is invisible
the JSON export is the project document, with every key in the documented order
export cards: board and column indexes, position null when archived, emails for people, field values by name, checklist by position
an empty project exports empty lists; viewers export, non-members get 404, format must be json or csv
the CSV export has the documented header with one field: column per field, CRLF row ends, no BOM and a text/csv content type
CSV cells: names for board and column, emails, ; joined lists, true/false, String(n) numbers, empty for null, and the documented quoting
CSV quoting: a cell is quoted only when it has a comma, a quote, CR or LF, or starts or ends with a space
CSV export lists every card by number, archived ones included, across all boards of the project
a CSV import creates a card per row with an empty number, at the end of its column, as one audited change with no events, rules or watchers
a CSV row with a number updates that card: every column present is set, another column moves it to the end there, history and completedAt follow
a CSV row for an archived card updates its other cells but does not move it; it stays archived
CSV header errors are row 0: unknown or repeated columns in header order, then the missing board, column and title
CSV row errors are all reported, by row and then header place, field_required last in its row, and nothing changes
a row with the wrong number of cells or an unterminated quote is the only error reported, and parsing stops there
dryRun checks everything the same way but changes nothing and appends no audit entry
imports ignore WIP limits and blocked, then check the cards quota for the created cards: 409 quota_exceeded imports nothing
a CSV export imported back into the same project updates every card and changes no value
project import body rules: csv a string, dryRun a boolean, admin+, 409 project_archived, and the 1 MiB body limit of the import routes
CSV import cells per field type: numbers by Number, checkbox true/false, user and assignee emails, ; split lists; bad cells are invalid_value
a team import creates the project with its fields, boards and cards: numbers kept, positions by position then document order, archived and done cards
team import: key and name may be overridden (body rules apply), the key used must be free, and document must be an object
team import validation answers the first broken value in document order as a JSON Pointer
team import drops people who are not members: an assignee must be member+, a user value any member
team import checks key_taken, then the projects quota, then the cards quota; it is one audited change with no events, rules or watchers
round trip: a project exported as JSON and imported under another key exports back to the same document but for key and name
CSV export writes numbers as String(n), checkbox false as false and unset values as empty cells
a team import of a document without fields, boards or cards creates an empty project whose first card is number 1
the summary of a project without cards has every count at zero and empty lists
the summary counts non-archived cards by category, priority, assignee (null first, then ids ascending) and label, with points
overdue counts open cards due before today: a card due today is not overdue, a completed one never is, and today moves with the clock
blocked counts cards with an open blocker; an archived or completed blocker is not open; archived cards are left out
cycle time measures from the first history entry into an in_progress column (else createdAt) to completedAt, ordered by completedAt
cycle time statistics: average rounded, median the middle value of an odd count, p85 the value at index ceil(0.85 * count) - 1; null when nothing completed
cycle time reads categories as they are now, and a startedAt after completedAt counts 0
cycle time ?from and ?to bound the date completedAt falls on, inclusively; bad dates or to before from are 400 invalid_query; archived cards are left out
flow counts, for each date, the cards created before its end in the category of the column they were in at its end
flow uses the current category of each historic column, falls back to the card's current column for a deleted one, and leaves archived cards out
flow needs from and to, to not before from, and at most 92 dates
the time report totals the project's entries in the date range, by user (ids ascending) and by card number, archived cards included
the time report with no entries in range is zero and empty; its from and to are validated
workload has one item per owner, admin and member in member order, counting their open cards in non-archived projects
reports are viewer+ and still answer for an archived project; non-members get 404 on every report
workload counts a member's open cards across every active project; a member who leaves drops out with their cards unassigned
cycle time and flow leave archived cards out, and a restored card counts again
points in the summary count null as 0, and points.done only the completed cards' points
a card completed, reopened and completed again: completedAt is the latest completion, startedAt its first in_progress entry
the summary byAssignee has no null entry when every card is assigned, and counts done per assignee
the summary counts per project: another project's cards are not in it
summary and workload follow the columns' current categories across every board of the project
the board page: title '<board> · <key>', one section per column by position, cards by position with title, assignee and labels
the board page leaves archived cards out
the card page: title '<key> <title>', an article with h1 and the dl fields column, assignee, priority, points, dueDate, labels in order
the card page writes the description escaped, each newline as
the card page holds the comment trees, oldest first, replies nested to any depth, a deleted comment shown as deleted
escaping: & < > " ' become & < > " ' in titles and text, and nothing else is replaced
the summary page: title 'Summary · <key>' and a summary table row per category with the summary report's counts
the notifications page lists the caller's visible notifications newest first with type and read state, at most 50
HTML routes answer errors as JSON: 401 without a token, 404 for unknown or invisible resources
pages authenticate like any route: a read API key gets them, and the board page of another project is reachable by its own id only
the card page shows a deleted comment that has replies with the replies kept, and a card without comments has an empty comments list
the notifications page shows only visible notifications: those of a team the caller left disappear, invitations always show
creating an invitation answers it with its token once: email lowercased, pending, expiring after invites.ttlMs, audited with email and role
invitation validation: an email by the account rules, role admin, member or viewer; a member's email is 409 already_member; admin+ only
inviting an email that already has a pending invitation revokes the old one; the list is oldest first
a pending invitation past expiresAt is shown, filtered and treated as expired, from exactly expiresAt
?status= filters by pending, accepted, declined, revoked, expired or all (the default); anything else is 400 invalid_query
accept: 404 for an unknown token, 403 for a caller with another email; the addressee joins with the role, member.added is emitted and audited
an expired invitation: accept and decline are 409 invite_expired, revoke still works
accept checks the members quota on the members alone: a full team answers 409 quota_exceeded and the invitation stays pending
create checks members plus pending, unexpired invitations against the members limit, not counting one to the same email
decline sets declined; another user's invitation id is 404; GET /me/invites lists the caller's pending invitations across teams, oldest first
revoke (DELETE) sets revoked on a pending invitation and is audited; accepted, declined or revoked ones are 409 invite_used; admin+ only
adding the addressee through the members route accepts their pending invitation by cascade; API keys may not accept
a team-restricted API key's /me/invites leaves out the invitations of other teams
archiving sets archived, archivedAt now and position null, closes the gap, keeps the rest, and is emitted and audited
archiving an archived card is 409 card_archived; in an archived project project_archived comes first; viewers get 403
an archived card leaves board lists, search, sprint lists, WIP counts and column_not_empty
an archived card is still returned by GET, the trash, the blocker lists and exports, but is never an open blocker
writes to an archived card answer 409 card_archived
on an archived card DELETE, watching, unwatching and stopping a running timer still work
restore with an empty body puts the card back at the end of its column, records history, and is emitted and audited
restore takes a column of the card's board and a position 0 .. n; other values, a non-object body and a card that is not archived are refused
restore checks the target column's WIP limit (409 wip_limit_reached) but not blocked
restore sets completedAt: kept for a done target when set, now for a done target when null, null for any other target
the trash lists archived cards newest archivedAt first, ties by number descending, with pagination; viewers read it, non-members get 404
an archived card is purged trash.retentionMs after archivedAt, on the next request: card.deleted with actor null and a card.purged audit entry
restoring or deleting cancels the purge; archiving again schedules it from the new archivedAt
with trash.retentionMs 0 an archived card is purged on the next request, even in an archived project, with its comments and attachment bytes
pending purge jobs survive a restart and run on the first request after their time
a manual time entry has the documented shape: the caller, source manual, date today by default and an empty note
minutes must be an integer 1 to 1440, date a real date not after today, note at most 500 chars
the card's minutesLogged is the sum of its entries and follows deletes; entries list oldest first
viewers read time entries but get 403 on logging and timers; non-members get 404
starting a timer answers { cardId, startedAt } and GET /me/timer shows it; a second start anywhere, another team included, is 409 timer_running
stop creates a timer entry dated today with minutes = min(1440, max(1, Math.round(elapsed / 60000))) and ends the timer
stop answers 409 no_timer unless the caller's running timer is on this card
a timer cannot start on an archived card or in an archived project, but a running one stops there
DELETE of a time entry: its user may always delete it, even as a viewer; others need admin+; non-members get 404
time entries emit no events; logging and timer stops are audited as time.logged with minutes, deletes as time.deleted, timers not at all
a running timer is discarded when its card is deleted and when its user leaves the card's team
a team-restricted API key sees { timer: null } for a timer on a card of another team, and acts as its owner
deleting a time entry still works in an archived project and on an archived card
time entries and a running timer survive a restart
a timer that runs past midnight is dated the day it stops
